LESSON: KUANDIKA 3.3.1 KUANDIKA KWA TARAKILISHI

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: Strand 3
Topic 3.3: Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo ni somo la kusoma: Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi. Soma maelezo, fuata mifano iliyofanyiwa kazi, kisha fanya mazoezi.

SEHEMU 2: MALENGO

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. Explain the main ideas in Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi
2. Give Kenyan examples for Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi
3. Practise Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi at school and at home

SEHEMU 3: SOMO (MAELEZO NA MIFANO)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: KUANDIKA 3.3.1 KUANDIKA KWA TARAKILISHI
This lesson teaches Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi for Grade 6 KISWAHILI.

STUDY STEPS
1. Explain the main ideas in Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. Give Kenyan examples for Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. Practise Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi at school and at home
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO YA HARAKA

Example 1: Describe Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: MAZOEZI

1. Underline the key ideas about Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi above.
2. Explain Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi.

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA NYUMBANI

1. Write five sentences about Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. Explain the main ideas in Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi
2. Give Kenyan examples for Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi
3. Practise Kuandika 3.3.1 Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi at school and at home
